name: No Light Shall Guide Thee

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 30 Thievery check (master) to subtly sift the ashes aside in a way where the curse simply fades without discerning a target or DC 33 Occultism check (expert) to know how to harmlessly disperse the malign magic

items.name: Devour Sight
items.text:
Trigger A creature disturbs the ashes in the fireplace or attempts to manipulate any of the evercursed crystals

---
Effect The crystals burn out, becoming non-magical stones, and the triggering creature must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature's vision blurs and dims, and they become Dazzled for 24 hours.

Failure As success, but with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded with an unlimited duration.

text: The evercursed crystals suddenly extinguish if they are disturbed, taking the PCs' sight away with their failing light.
